title: 09-febe-matrix-surface-menu-workflows
summary: Audited the 38 documented Surface Tools rows against the code, authored icons, Matrix scripts and option sheets. Every row is Implemented with a unique command id, an authored icon that menu_catalog::SURFACE and icons.rs embed, and the Matrix script name; the menu click and the typed script/label resolve to the same feature through resolve_alias/resolve_typed_command, and each row runs its owner service through surface_edit/om9_core::surface_ops as one transaction/Undo. Behavior gaps closed this round: Sweep 1/2 History Closed became conditional (closed rail + two profiles, hidden and refused otherwise), Soft Edit now exposes UDistance/VDistance/Copy/FixEdges/DirConstraint with typed U/V and Dx/Dy/Dz, Match Surfaces now supports Continuity Position/Tangency/Curvature committed on Enter, and the two last dead menu icons were implemented: Smash (OM9-SURFACE-141) flattens with surface_ops::smash and reports the measured stretch, and surface Refit to Tolerance (OM9-SURFACE-142) waits for Tolerance= and rebuilds with surface_ops::refit_to_tolerance. All 40 authored menu icons now reach an available command; the 16 rows without an owner candidate name OM9-L2-03-17 and the catalog test asserts one.

checks.name: surface kernel smash and refit to tolerance

menu_coverage: menu_catalog::SURFACE has all 40 authored icons and all 40 resolve to an available command: 38 milestone rows plus the four menu-only owners (Revolve OM9-SURFACE-018, Heightfield from Image OM9-SURFACE-031, Smash OM9-SURFACE-141, RefitSrf OM9-SURFACE-142). No authored menu icon is a placeholder any more.
script_names: 37/38 Matrix scripts appear verbatim in the authored sheets; Surface Extrude All has no quoted script and accepts ExtrudeCrv plus its authored label
remaining: Soft Edit takes its base point and move as typed U/V and Dx/Dy/Dz because the viewport does not project a click onto surface UV parameters yet.
Smash reports a sampling-level stretch instead of an exact isometry error, and Refit to Tolerance bounds its search to degree 1..=3 and 4..=24 poles per direction, measured on a 9×9 parameter grid.
Human M03-UI click/preview review is unsigned.

The whole-app suite carries pre-existing failures outside this module (rewrites of ui/command.rs, ui/files.rs and session/solid.rs in flight, plus the recorded mesh_fill/ui_events CPU-painter tests); the module's own targets are green.
